material_news_signals.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
material_news_signals.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

material_news_signals.description: Washington Commanders general manager Adam Peters took an optimistic stance on Jayden Daniels’ recovery from his latest elbow injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: the commanders took an optimistic stance friday on jayden daniels recovery from his latest elbow injury as of right now surgery is not on the table and we haven t discussed injured reserve general manager adam peters said friday morning on the sports junkies on 106 7 the fan radio so it s just a matter of how we re going to get him back on the field that s still to be determined the most notable part of peters comment was that washington doesn t view ir as an option right now meaning the club expects the quarterback back sooner than a four week absence that would be required if he goes on ir coach dan quinn confirmed later friday that daniels will not be placed on ir as peters indicated the former offensive rookie of the year is considered week to week after undergoing imaging and consulting with multiple specialists about the injury to gain clarity on the extent of his absence like most things when you want to wait it out you go through the what ifs in your head and sometimes those are worse than the actual news quinn said what a great bit of news for him and for us daniels went down at the end of the first half of sunday s loss to dallas after a lineman stepped on him the qb tried to brace his fall with his non throwing arm which bent awkwardly daniels was later diagnosed with a dislocated elbow last year daniels season was also knocked off kilter and eventually ended by injuries to the same elbow peters comments don t provide a clear timeline for daniels returning to the field quinn said on monday that the expectation is marcus mariota will start sunday against seattle however with daniels not expected to land on ir there is a shot the qb returns in the next few weeks washington plays indianapolis in london in week 4 hosts the new york giants in week 5 and travels to san francisco to face the 49ers in prime time in week 6 before a bye

material_news_signals.headline: Zach Ertz silences the 'what-if' with Eagles return. Can he play Monday?
material_news_signals.body_text: philadelphia 34 obviously some things have changed around here 34 zach ertz said the tight end took in the locker room 34 a little bigger 34 he said he 39 d walked through the training room 34 a little better 34 he said he stood there smiling about a homecoming with the philadelphia eagles which he said was long overdue he stood there shifting his weight onto the right knee that made any return to football doubtful ertz tore the acl and lcl in that knee on dec 7 it was a violent injury it was an emotional injury it arrived near the end of his final one year contract with the washington commanders ertz 35 did not know if he would ever play again but he credited his wife julie and their three young boys with motivating his comeback he wanted to set an example for his sons to look back on when they face their own adversities 34 i was gonna do everything i could to get back and i could live with those results 34 ertz said 34 but if i couldn 39 t then i would know i 39 d be at peace but i couldn 39 t live with the fact that i just gave up and there was a 39 what if 39 hanging over my life for the rest of my life 34 now ertz 39 s name is hanging over a green laden locker he stood beneath it waxing nostalgic about 34 a place i 39 ve always called home 34 the eagles picked him no 35 in 2013 one round after right tackle lane johnson ertz got emotional seeing johnson again and owner jeffrey lurie and general manager howie roseman and facility staffers and even first time offensive coordinator sean mannion whom ertz had played against while growing up in california 39 s east bay 34 i beat him in high school 34 ertz said 34 just so we 39 re throwing that out there 34 just don 39 t say this reunion went all according to plan 34 i mean there was never a plan to come back obviously i never wanted to leave in the first place 34 said ertz whom the eagles traded in 2021 amid disagreements over a contract extension 34 the opportunity finally arose that i could come back there 39 s been times i 39 ve asked in the past and it didn 39 t come to fruition for whatever reason but for me it 39 s just a blessing to be back if you told me when i got hurt that i 39 d be back here in nine and a half months practicing for the philadelphia eagles you could have signed me up then 34 ertz 39 s homecoming is a heartening storyline it could culminate in ertz surpassing harold carmichael 39 s franchise record for career receptions he needs 11 catches though ertz said it 34 couldn 39 t be further from the truth 34 that he returned to chase the record practical matters are more pressing an in season problem prompted the eagles to bring ertz back starting tight end dallas goedert sprained his mcl against the tennessee titans and his weekslong recovery timeline effectively launched the break glass scenario for a precarious position group the franchise tried to strengthen in the offseason ertz 39 s own recovery remains an obstacle ertz said his right knee 34 feels great 34 but he acknowledged that he still needs to get it game ready after nearly 10 months away from the field it raises questions about how much ertz can contribute monday night against the chicago bears if the eagles promote him from the practice squad at all ertz must also learn a playbook he said is 34 all new to me 34 ertz acknowledged that he has never really played in an offense centered on the wide zone run game he said he 39 s spent the last few days 34 trying to do a crash course on this offense 34 which included poring over the team 39 s training camp playbooks he said there were maybe 34 two or three pass plays 34 left over from when coach nick sirianni installed his first ever playbook in 2021 sirianni said earlier thursday that the route concepts resemble those in other offenses ertz agreed the language of the plays is new which sirianni likened to someone learning french after speaking english on wednesday mannion gave ertz a vote of confidence saying his 14 year career reflects 34 a really strong record 34 as a 34 very very comfortable pass catcher 34 and a comfortable pass catcher is exactly what the eagles knew they might need managing injuries at tight end is not a new subject for them they arranged consecutive one year contracts for goedert partly due to the 31 year old 39 s injury history but they built their new offensive system around a clear need at tight end with goedert as the position group 39 s only proven pass catcher the other tight ends the eagles carried into the regular season have never totaled more than 20 catches in a season johnny mundt a 10 year veteran was a free agent upgrade for their blocking needs e j jenkins a 2023 practice squad pickup has been targeted once in his 132 career offensive snaps mannion said wednesday that despite what mundt 39 s and jenkins 39 statistical catalogs may say the eagles set being 34 a two way player 34 as a prerequisite for playing tight end in this system and that 34 we feel good about the group 34 roseman raved about jenkins 39 inclusion on the initial 53 man roster in august roseman underlined how jenkins was a former wide receiver at georgia tech who weighed 225 pounds in his final game jenkins is 6 foot 6 and 260 pounds after two years with the eagles roseman called jenkins an effective run blocker at the point of attack in their wide zone concepts and in pass protection but also noted his history as a wide receiver calling him 34 a big target in the passing game 34 34 i mean i know it hasn 39 t been put on display yet but it 39 s always going to be there 34 jenkins said 34 it 39 s not just going to disappear 34 second round pick eli stowers offers little short term insurance the 2025 mackey award winner for the nation 39 s top tight end offers undeniable upside as a pass catcher but the eagles saw stowers 39 lean frame and lack of blocking as a development project to meet the two way prerequisite their system requires stowers is now sidelined and so is depth tight end grant calcaterra who went on injured reserve aug 30 with a back injury the eagles placed stowers on ir with hamstring and quadriceps injuries the day before the regular season opener he must miss at least four games but his tepid progress before the injury casts doubt on how much he can contribute in 2026 roseman emphasized a 34 long term view 34 when discussing stowers at the end of training camp the eagles are still acting on that view they placed ertz in a locker next to stowers supplying young talent with veteran mentors is an organizational staple 34 i don 39 t think it 39 s an accident that they put me here 34 ertz said 34 everyone 39 s got a superpower in this league 34 ertz said of stowers 34 and he 39 s got to play to his superpower and i 39 m looking forward to helping him kind of unlock that mentally physically to be at his best 34 ertz was the eagles 39 most available option in their contingency plan ertz made his interest in a return to philly known throughout the offseason the eagles appeared cautious on the same day roseman addressed stowers 39 status with reporters he acknowledged that he 39 d spoken with ertz 34 over a period of time 34 to maintain their relationship and understand where ertz was in his recovery he balanced praise for ertz by calling him 34 one of the greatest tight ends to play the game 34 with a note that he was 34 excited about the tight ends that we have here 34 the tact behind roseman 39 s words reflected the politics at play in 2021 ertz was then at the same stage in his career as goedert is now ertz secured the contract he 39 d coveted in arizona five years later with ertz wanting to return to philly and the eagles wanting proven depth a reunion made sense 34 everything 39 s discussed everything has a plan 34 sirianni said 34 that 39 s what i appreciate so much about howie everything 39 s thought out everything 39 s got a plan and here we are today in the situation we 39 re in and zach being here i 39 m excited about that opportunity for him 34 the eagles have friday and saturday practices before they must make a decision about ertz if they aim to dress three tight ends against the bears their only other option right now is promoting josiah deguara from the practice squad deguara a seventh year veteran played in 12 games for the cardinals in 2025 in a blocking oriented role but ertz underlined that he isn 39 t yet even on the active roster it 39 s up to the coaches to decide whether his play in practice merits a return on monday night 34 it 39 s about going out there and proving that i can make a difference in the game 34 ertz said 34 if i can 39 t make a difference in the game then i shouldn 39 t be out there 34 this material_news_signals.headline: Giants' Jameis Winston returns to starting QB role after Jaxson Dart injury: 'This is what I dream of'
material_news_signals.description: The New York Giants are now Jameis Winston’s team. After being called into emergency action on Monday night in Los Angeles, Winston has a game to prepare for.
material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants are now jameis winston s team it s a product of unfortunate circumstances usual starter jaxson dart suffered a knee injury that will require surgery but there s little time to waste on acknowledging misfortune after being called into emergency action on monday night in los angeles winston has a game to prepare for this is what i ve always dreamed of to be a starting quarterback winston told reporters wednesday ahead of new york s week 3 matchup with tennessee obviously my respects and gratitude is just going to be with jaxson but at the same time this is what i dream of i dream of being what i am right now and executing at a high level winston certainly didn t execute at a high level when he replaced the injured dart on monday night completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception in the 28 6 defeat he s been here before though starting in place of dart for two games last season that both ended in one score losses winston s experience and performance in spot starts convinced the giants to reward him with a two year 13 million extension earlier in september securing a veteran backup they can trust they just didn t expect to have to turn to him so quickly that s life in the nfl as a backup quarterback though and after being one play away from seeing the field winston can count on it for the rest of the regular season it s truly a privilege he said i had this privilege for two games last year it truly was an honor but for this game alone my focus is on being my very best going out there and having elite fundamentals and precise execution and that s what it starts with and it s as simple as that no matter how big it may seem being present and focused on doing all that you can do with what you have with where you are for right now that s keeping jaxson s spirits uplifted and going out there on that football field and being the new york football giants starting quarterback right now winston is a guaranteed manufacturer of fun playing a wild and often reckless style of quarterback with the arm talent and athleticism to produce big plays the former no 1 pick also comes with what is essentially a guarantee to commit crushing mistakes at the worst possible times as the founder of the 30 30 club 30 touchdowns 30 interceptions thrown in a single season winston s unpredictability has defined his career he s liable to throw for 400 yards but he s just as likely to throw three interceptions or a game losing pick six he did all three as a member of the browns in a 2024 loss to denver winston once even called to the heavens for help after throwing an interception returned for a touchdown telling reporters he was praying for the lord to deliver me from pick sixes the giants will want him to be himself but also keep things between the lines it s their best chance of overcoming the loss of dart and proving themselves as a competitive team worthy of new york s support the fans want to see wins winston said it s not about what i m showing them it s about us going out there and winning football games together giving them something to cheer for giving them something to stand behind but right now my heart this is fresh the opportunity is beautiful it s amazing i m grateful for it but at the same time i ve got a brother that i ve got to keep lifted up and i have to prepare for a football game but i ve prepared for many football games and i ve dealt with injury before i ve had an injury that was really bad so balancing the two but keeping a perspective of do what you can material_news_signals.body_text: the denver broncos are placing rookie running back jonah coleman on short term injured reserve as he manages an ankle sprain the team announced saturday in a series of roster moves coleman a fourth round pick out of the university of washington had already been ruled out of sunday night 39 s game against the visiting los angeles rams after missing all three practices this week coleman must sit out at least three additional games as he will not be eligible to return until denver 39 s week 7 game at the arizona cardinals coleman suffered the ankle injury during denver 39 s week 2 victory against the jacksonville jaguars he stayed in the game and made a strong contribution in the fourth quarter as the broncos rallied from a 10 point deficit to notch their first win of the season 20 13 coleman scored the go ahead touchdown his first in the nfl on a 3 yard run midway through the final period he then rushed six times for 33 yards on denver 39 s final drive which chewed up the clock and ended with the team kneeling in victory formation coleman the only broncos rookie to play so far this season was needed late against the jaguars because second year back rj harvey was out with a hamstring injury and starter j k dobbins left with a hip injury late in the third quarter coleman finished the game with 58 yards on 13 carries he showed veteran savvy on his final carry when after picking up a first down he slid to the ground inbounds allowing denver to run out the clock harvey and dobbins fully participated in practice thursday and friday and have been cleared to play against the rams veteran tyler badie also figures to be in the backfield rotation sunday after he accounted for 113 all purpose yards in week 2 going forward the broncos could also turn to cody schrader who is in his second season on the team 39 s practice squad and was a standout for denver in the preseason to replace coleman on the active roster the broncos are promoting long snapper mitch fraboni from the practice squad according to the league 39 s transaction wire fullback adam prentice and wide receiver returner kolbe katsis are being elevated from the practice squad for sunday 39 s game this article originally appeared in the athletic
